title: Auto Restart Tomcat If Failed
description: Check Tomcat and automatically restart it when the service is inactive.
script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

SERVICE="${SERVICE:-tomcat}"
MAX_RETRIES="${MAX_RETRIES:-3}"

if systemctl is-active --quiet "$SERVICE"; then
    echo "$SERVICE is running."
    exit 0
fi

echo "WARNING: $SERVICE is not running. Attempting restart..."

for ((i=1; i<=MAX_RETRIES; i++)); do
    sudo systemctl restart "$SERVICE"
    sleep 5

    if systemctl is-active --quiet "$SERVICE"; then
        echo "$SERVICE restarted successfully."
        exit 0
    fi

    echo "Restart attempt $i failed."
done

echo "ERROR: Unable to restore $SERVICE after $MAX_RETRIES attempts." >&2
exit 1
